program_dir.ask: Folder on the CrystalClear PC (as a share) where program files are placed for import
program_dir.help: Any folder the person running CrystalClear can import from; writable by the account that runs mhp.

export_dir.ask: Folder where CrystalClear exports the data report CSV files
export_dir.help: Set CrystalClear's export (or auto-export) to this folder; one CSV per block, named after the program.
